description: 한국동서발전(주)_발전소별 탈황 설비 현황 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국동서발전(주). 한국동서발전에서 오픈API 형태로 제공하는 발전소별 탈황 설비 현황 데이터는 발전 과정에서 발생하는 부산물의 재활용 실적과 성과를 종합적으로 파악하고 분석할 수 있도록 구성된 자료입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국동서발전(주). Its tags are 탈황설비, 자원재활용, 발전소, 성과분석, 기술연구. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-12-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
